arxiv-2004-06023.title: Moment map for coupled equations of Kähler forms and curvature
arxiv-2004-06023.creator: King Leung Lee
arxiv-2004-06023.description: Abstract . In this paper we introduce two new systems of equations in Kähler geometry: The coupled p equation and the generalized coupled cscK equation. We motivate the equations from the moment map pictures, prove the uniqueness of solutions and find out the obstructions to the solutions for the second equation.

arxiv-2107-05918.title: Experimental validation of fluid inertia models for a cylinder settling in a quiescent flow
arxiv-2107-05918.creator: F. Cabrera, M.Z. Sheikh, B. Mehlig, N. Plihon, M. Bourgoin, A. Pumir, A. Naso
arxiv-2107-05918.description: Abstract The precise description of the motion of anisotropic particles in a flow rests on the understanding of the force and torque acting on them. Here, we study experimentally small, very elongated particles settling in a fluid at small Reynolds number.

arxiv-2112-14837.title: Recent Trends in Artificial Intelligence-inspired Electronic Thermal Management
arxiv-2112-14837.creator: Aviral Chharia ( 🖂 ) *, Nishi Mehta*, Shivam Gupta*, Shivam Prajapati*
arxiv-2112-14837.description: Abstract The rise of computation-based methods in thermal management has gained immense attention in recent years due to the ability of deep learning to solve complex ‘physics’ problems, which are otherwise difficult to be approached using conventional techniques. Thermal management is required in electronic systems to keep them from overheating and burning, enhancing their efficiency and lifespan.

arxiv-2203-14663.title: Clusters in an epidemic model with long-range dispersal
arxiv-2203-14663.creator: Xiangyu Cao, Pierre Le Doussal, Alberto Rosso
arxiv-2203-14663.description: Abstract In presence of long range dispersal, epidemics spread in spatially disconnected regions known as clusters. Here, we characterize exactly their statistical properties in a solvable model, in both the supercritical (outbreak) and critical regimes. We identify two diverging length scales, corresponding to the bulk and the outskirt of the epidemic.

arxiv-2209-11561.title: Three-dimensional Lagrangian Coherent Structures in the Elliptic-Restricted Three-body Problem
arxiv-2209-11561.creator: Tyler, Jack, Wittig, Alexander
arxiv-2209-11561.description: Abstract In the preliminary design of space missions it can be useful to identify regions of dynamics that drive the system’s behaviour or separate qualitatively different dynamics. The Lagrangian Coherent Structure (LCS) has been widely used in the analysis of dynamical systems, and generalises the concept of the stable and unstable manifolds to systems with arbitrary time-dependence.

arxiv-2306-04433.description: Abstract The classification of electrocardiogram (ECG) plays a crucial role in the development of an automatic cardiovascular diagnostic system. However, considerable variances in ECG signals between individuals is a significant challenge. Changes in data distribution limit cross-domain utilization of a model.

arxiv-2306-07340.title: Conformal Invariance and Multifractality at Anderson Transitions in Arbitrary Dimensions
arxiv-2306-07340.creator: Jaychandran Padayasi, Ilya Gruzberg
arxiv-2306-07340.description: Abstract Multifractals arise in various systems across nature whose scaling behavior is characterized by a continuous spectrum of multifractal exponents Δ q \Delta_{q} . In the context of Anderson transitions, the multifractality of critical wave functions is described by operators O q O_{q} with scaling dimensions Δ q \Delta_{q} in a field-theory description of the transitions.

arxiv-2310-20588.title: Zero-Shot Medical Information Retrieval via Knowledge Graph Embedding
arxiv-2310-20588.creator: Yuqi Wang 1 3, Zeqiang Wang 1, Wei Wang 1, Qi Chen 1, Kaizhu Huang 2, Anh Nguyen 3, Suparna De 4
arxiv-2310-20588.description: Abstract In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), the retrieval of relevant medical information has become essential for efficient clinical decision-making. This paper introduces MedFusionRank, a novel approach to zero-shot medical information retrieval (MIR) that combines the strengths of pre-trained language models and statistical methods while addressing their limitations.

arxiv-2405-07461.title: The evolution of supermassive blackhole mass–bulge mass relation by a semi-analytic model, ν 2 \nu^{2} GC
arxiv-2405-07461.creator: Tatsuki Shimizu, Taira Oogi, Takashi Okamoto, Masahiro Nagashima, Motohiro Enoki
arxiv-2405-07461.description: Abstract We have investigated the redshift evolution of the relationship between supermassive black hole (SMBH) mass and host bulge mass using a semi-analytical galaxy formation model ν 2 \nu^{2} GC. Our model reproduces the relation in the local universe well.

arxiv-2410-04839.title: Lifts of Logarithmic Derivatives
arxiv-2410-04839.creator: Matthias Grätsch
arxiv-2410-04839.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matthias Grätsch. Consider a sequence of meromorphic functions ( f n ) n (f_{n})_{n} . This paper presents a technique that enables the transfer of convergence properties from ( f n ( m + 1 ) / f n ( m ) ) n (f_{n}^{(m+1)}/f_{n}^{(m)})_{n} to subsequences of ( f n ( m ) / f n ( m − 1 ) ) n (f_{n}^{(m)}/f_{n}^{(m-1)})_{n} . As an application, we will show that the families of functions with bounded Schwarzian derivative are quasi-normal.

arxiv-2503-12600.title: GraphEval : A Lightweight Graph-Based LLM Framework for Idea Evaluation
arxiv-2503-12600.creator: Tao Feng, Yihang Sun, Jiaxuan You
arxiv-2503-12600.description: Abstract The powerful capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have led to their growing use in evaluating human-generated content, particularly in evaluating research ideas within academic settings. Existing solutions primarily rely on prompt-based LLM methods or fine-tuned lightweight language models for idea evaluation.

arxiv-2505-07662.description: Abstract Background: With rising temperatures and an aging population, understanding how to prevent heat-related illness among older adults will be increasingly crucial. Despite biological plausibility, no study to date has investigated how exposure to fine particulate matter air pollution (PM 2.

arxiv-2507-19616.title: HITSZ’s End-To-End Speech Translation Systems Combining Sequence-to-Sequence Auto Speech Recognition Model and Indic Large Language Model for IWSLT 2025 in Indic Track
arxiv-2507-19616.creator: Xuchen Wei , Yangxin Wu , Yaoyin Zhang , Henglyu Liu, Kehai Chen, Xuefeng Bai, Min Zhang School of Computer Science and Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China {2023311524,2023311526,2023313720,23s151043}@stu.hit.edu.cn, {chenkehai,baixuefeng,zhangmin2021}@hit.edu.cn
arxiv-2507-19616.description: Abstract This paper presents HITSZ’s submission for the IWSLT 2025 Indic track, focusing on speech-to-text translation (ST) for English-to-Indic and Indic-to-English language pairs. To enhance translation quality in this low-resource scenario, we propose an end-to-end system integrating the pre-trained Whisper automated speech recognition (ASR) model with Krutrim, an Indic-specialized large language model (LLM).

arxiv-2508-21779.title: Quantum Phase Sensitivity with Generalized Coherent States Based on Deformed
arxiv-2508-21779.creator: s
arxiv-2508-21779.description: Abstract We investigate the phase sensitivity of a Mach–Zehnder interferometer using a special class of generalized coherent states constructed from generalized Heisenberg and deformed su(1,1) algebras. These states, derived from a perturbed harmonic oscillator with a four-parameter deformed spectrum, provide enhanced tunability and nonclassical features.

arxiv-2512-23440.title: ClinDEF: A Dynamic Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models in Clinical Reasoning
arxiv-2512-23440.creator: Yuqi Tang, Jing Yu, Zichang Su, Kehua Feng, Zhihui Zhu, Libin Wang, Lei Liang, Qiang Zhang, Keyan Ding, Huajun Chen
arxiv-2512-23440.description: Abstract Clinical diagnosis begins with doctor-patient interaction, during which physicians iteratively gather information, determine examination and refine differential diagnosis through patients’ response. This dynamic clinical-reasoning process is poorly represented by existing LLM benchmarks that focus on static question-answering. To mitigate these gaps, recent methods explore dynamic medical frameworks involving interactive clinical dialogues.

arxiv-2602-06618.title: Structured Learning for Electromagnetic Field Modeling and Real-Time Inversion
arxiv-2602-06618.creator: António Bernardes 1 2 , Jasan Zughaibi 1 2 , Michael Muehlebach 3 , Bradley J. Nelson 2
arxiv-2602-06618.description: Abstract Precise magnetic field modeling is fundamental to the closed-loop control of electromagnetic navigation systems (eMNS) and the analytical Multipole Expansion Model (MPEM) is the current standard. However, the MPEM relies on strict physical assumptions regarding source symmetry and isolation, and requires optimization-based calibration that is highly sensitive to initialization.

pmc-10486359.title: Differences in the Clinical and Molecular Profiles of Subungual Melanoma and Acral Melanoma in Asian Patients
pmc-10486359.creator: So-Young Ahn, Go-Eun Bae, Seung-Yeol Park, Min-Kyung Yeo, Nicolas Dumaz
pmc-10486359.description: Simple SummaryMelanoma is a type of skin cancer that develops from melanocytes (the cells that give the skin its brown color). Subungual melanoma (nail melanoma) is a rare type of malignant melanoma that arises beneath the nails. Subungual melanoma has been categorized as a type of acral melanoma, which occurs on the hands and feet.

pmc-10651418.title: Comparative Efficacy and Safety of Neoadjuvant Immunotherapy with Chemotherapy versus Chemotherapy Alone in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: A Propensity Score and Inverse Probability Treatment Weighting Analysis
pmc-10651418.creator: Junfeng Zhao, Shaoyu Hao, Ying Li, Xiaoman Liu, Zhaoxuan Liu, Chunhui Zheng, Dan Han
pmc-10651418.description: PurposeThis study aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NCT) and neoadjuvant immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy (NICT) combined with radical lung cancer resection for the treatment of patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). To adjust for confounding factors, we innovatively adopted two matching methods: propensity score (PS) and inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW).

pmc-12370928.title: Two-year results of switching to intravitreal administration of faricimab in patients with aflibercept-refractory neovascular age-related macular degeneration
pmc-12370928.creator: Masaaki Saito, Kimihiro Imaizumi
pmc-12370928.description: We evaluated the efficacy of switching to intravitreal injection of faricimab (IVF) in patients with aflibercept-refractory neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) over 2 years of follow-up. We retrospectively reviewed 47 consecutive eyes of 45 Japanese patients with nAMD who switched from aflibercept to faricimab. Thirty-one eyes of 30 Japanese patients were included in this study.

pmc-12469181.title: Breast Immunology Network: Toward a Multidisciplinary and Integrated Model for Breast Cancer Care in Italy
pmc-12469181.creator: Andrea Botticelli, Ovidio Brignoli, Francesco Caruso, Giuseppe Curigliano, Vincenzo Di Lauro, Carla Masini, Mario Taffurelli, Giuseppe Viale
pmc-12469181.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryBreast cancer is the most common cancer among women in Italy. Although survival has improved thanks to earlier diagnoses and new treatments, many patients still face unequal access to care depending on where they live. This paper proposes the Breast Immunology Network (BIN), a coordinated system that brings together healthcare professionals and centers to ensure more consistent, personalized, and timely care.

pmc-12578984.title: First report and diversity analysis of endophytic fungi associated with Ulva sp. from Iran
pmc-12578984.creator: Maryam Besharati-Fard, S Ali Moosawi-Jorf, Masoomeh Shams-Ghahfarokhi, Mehdi Razzaghi-Abyaneh
pmc-12578984.description: Endophytic fungi are diverse microorganisms that colonize plants symbiotically without causing overt infections. While numerous studies have focused on endophytes in terrestrial plants, there are no prior reports of endophytes associated with algae in Iran. Samples of Ulva sp. were collected during the fall of 2022 from the Bandar Abbas Fishery Coast, Iran, and transported to the laboratory.

pmc-12683604.description: AimsChronic periprosthetic joint infections (PJIs) caused by low-virulence pathogens can be challenging to differentiate from aseptic failure. pmc-12693003.title: Study on the Mechanism and Modification of Carbon-Based Materials for Pollutant Treatment
pmc-12693003.creator: Lingyi Meng, Zitong Shao, Wenqi Li, Jianxiong Wang, Changqing Hu, Guangqing Yang, Yan Shi, Mihkel Koel
pmc-12693003.description: Highlights What are the main findings? The core mechanisms by which carbon-based materials treat water, atmospheric, and soil pollutants have been elucidated, including adsorption mechanisms (clearly distinguishing between physical and chemical adsorption) and physicochemical degradation mechanisms. Concurrently, the degradation characteristics of different carbon-based materials and their specific impacts on pollutant treatment efficacy have been analyzed.

pmc-12998072.title: Revisiting PIV in lung cancer: bridging prognostic insights with clinical applicability
pmc-12998072.creator: Huazhen Wu, Jia Liao, Lishan Hu, Siwen Li
pmc-12998072.description: nvincingly demonstrated that elevated pan-immune-inflammation value (PIV) is associated with poorer overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) in lung cancer patients. This work stands out for its robust methodology, comprehensive subgroup analyses, and timely focus on immunotherapy—a treatment domain in urgent need of reliable biomarkers.

pmc-13338194.title: A vision-based multi-camera fusion and CAD projection framework for risk-point identification in metro stations
pmc-13338194.creator: Yichao Pu, Qianqi Fan, Shengyu Zhang, Qi Zhang, Jianyong Zuo
pmc-13338194.description: Metro systems face challenges in managing localized congestion and ensuring passenger safety, particularly under high-density passenger flows and unexpected disruption scenarios. Conventional crowd detection methods often fail due to severe occlusion, insufficient coverage, and excessive latency, making them unreliable for providing operators with accurate risk identification and control support.

pmc-13360634.title: Large‐Diameter DNA‐Scaffolded Nanopores Enabled by Loosely Packed Peptides for Single‐Molecule Sensing
pmc-13360634.creator: Zugui Peng, Daisuke Noshiro, Shiroh Futaki, Ryuji Kawano
pmc-13360634.description: Creating alternative nanopores is crucial for advancing single‐molecule methodologies. Peptide nanopores scaffolded by DNA nanostructures have emerged as a promising class of chemically synthesizable nanopores with organized geometries. However, no such nanopores have yet achieved single‐molecule detection due to size limitations.

pmc-13366180.title: Enhancing EEG based cognitive state classification using graph Fourier transform
pmc-13366180.creator: Shweta Sharma, Ayushi Kotwal, Rajneet Kaur Bijral, Vinod Sharma, Jatinder Manhas
pmc-13366180.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) based cognitive state classification has been widely explored with deep-learning models demonstrating remarkable performance. Deep-learning models need high computational resources and large datasets, creating a need for an alternative methodology. Graph signal processing (GSP) techniques provide an effective lightweight alternative by capturing spatial dependencies across the channels.

pmc-13457556.title: Analysis of toxicity and mechanism of xylazine on testis with network toxicology and molecular docking strategy
pmc-13457556.creator: Shanyong Yi, Jiahui Li, Xianxian Zhang, Shuquan Zhao
pmc-13457556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Xylazine, an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist originally developed as a veterinary sedative, has increasingly been detected as an adulterant in illicit drug supplies, particularly in combination with opioids such as fentanyl. This emerging pattern of misuse poses significant health risks and imposes a growing social burden, underscoring the urgent need to develop a rapid and comprehensive research strategy to investigate the potential toxicological mechanisms of xylazine.

pmc-13571861.title: Social Media Addiction in Adolescents and the Effect of Emotional Intelligence on Ghosting
pmc-13571861.creator: Ramazan İnci, Sevgi Köroğlu Gökbel, Hatice Kiliçkiran Doğan, Nursel Gül, Kübra Yesin, Metin Yıldız
pmc-13571861.description: Objective This study was conducted to examine the effect of social media addiction and emotional intelligence on ghosting among adolescents. Methods This descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted between June and September 2025 using an online survey method. The study was conducted with 425 adolescents aged 10–19 years living in Batman, Türkiye. R programming language 4.1.3, G*Power 3.
